description: Scrape Bing search results as structured JSON.

cc.description: Two-letter ISO country code. Mutually exclusive with mkt.

first.description: Result offset to start from. (API default: 1)

lat.description: GPS latitude for the search origin.

lon.description: GPS longitude for the search origin.

mkt.description: Market as language-country, e.g. en-US. Mutually exclusive with cc.

query.description: Bing search query; supports standard Bing operators.

name: bing_search
title: Bing Search API
